reviewer: Codex repository review; hand-labeled execution semantics, not external validation

cases.source:
import time
async def work():
    time.sleep(1)
cases.reason: Direct synchronous sleep blocks the event loop.

cases.source:
import time
def helper():
    time.sleep(1)
async def work():
    helper()
cases.reason: The helper runs blocking sleep on the same thread.
This direct callback invoker runs sleep synchronously.

cases.source:
from pathlib import Path
async def work():
    Path("data").read_text()
cases.reason: File reading uses synchronous filesystem I/O.

cases.source:
import requests
async def work():
    requests.Session().get("url")

import time
async def work():
    (lambda: time.sleep(1))()
cases.reason: The lambda is invoked immediately on the event loop; retained as a regression probe.

cases.source:
import time
def store(fn):
    return fn
async def work():
    store(time.sleep)
cases.reason: Storing a callable does not invoke it.

cases.source:
import asyncio
import time
async def work():
    await asyncio.to_thread(time.sleep, 1)
cases.reason: The synchronous callback executes in a worker thread.

def open(value):

async def work():
